headline: Méliuz Shares Drop 9% on Weak E-commerce Environment
summary: Méliuz shares fell nearly 10% following a third-quarter report showing operational deceleration. The company cited a difficult online retail environment and the judicial reorganization of Casas Bahia as key pressures.
why: Méliuz's performance reflects the broader challenges facing the Brazilian fintech and e-commerce sectors amid economic headwinds.

impacts.name: Méliuz
impacts.why: The company reported operational deceleration and weak quarterly results.
